selection_rules: Five of eight initial families independently developed; three report suggestions, no ranking taken from PDF.

Short cards and field controls before deep competition work. Select no more than four families for original measurement attempts, no more than eight ordinary starts for any family; do not use all budget on one candidate.
Original positive examples are purposive measurement controls, never an untouched empirical sample. No association, returns, outcome-based tuning or economic pilot.

Use Gate M requirements individually; pathway-only outcomes remain provisional. H is separate: 5-20-session expectation revision must have an identified event, not merely annual statement availability.
F19 is a preserved opportunity-cost benchmark; no annual-PDF download, new F19 request, old budget consumption or SH09 activation.
Unknown required fields remain UNVERIFIED. A material reformulation or proxy is a new claim version; retain old stop. Reject/hold/verify/M passed are evidence dispositions, not experiment states.

Record raw bodies/errors and reservation receipts under ignored new data/raw/measurement_gate_campaign_20261021/; reuse isolated existing collectors/projection logic, no new public framework or dependencies.
